1: # Implementation Tasks
2: 
3: ## Phase 1: Foundation & Architecture
4: 
5: - [x] Create `src/utils/shell-detection.ts` with `SupportedShell` type and `detectShell()` function
6: - [x] Create `src/core/completions/types.ts` with interfaces: `CompletionGenerator`, `CommandDefinition`, `FlagDefinition`
7: - [x] Create `src/core/completions/command-registry.ts` with `COMMAND_REGISTRY` constant defining all OpenSpec commands, flags, and metadata
8: - [x] Create `src/core/completions/completion-provider.ts` with `CompletionProvider` class for dynamic change/spec ID discovery with 2-second caching
9: - [x] Write tests for shell detection (`test/utils/shell-detection.test.ts`)
10: - [x] Write tests for completion provider (`test/core/completions/completion-provider.test.ts`)
11: 
12: ## Phase 2: Zsh Completion (Oh My Zsh Priority)
13: 
14: - [x] Create `src/core/completions/generators/zsh-generator.ts` implementing `CompletionGenerator` interface
15: - [x] Implement Zsh script generation using `_arguments` and `_describe` patterns
16: - [x] Add dynamic completion logic for change/spec IDs using completion provider
17: - [x] Test Zsh generator output (`test/core/completions/generators/zsh-generator.test.ts`)
18: - [x] Create `src/core/completions/installers/zsh-installer.ts` with Oh My Zsh and standard Zsh support
19: - [x] Implement Oh My Zsh detection (`$ZSH` env var or `~/.oh-my-zsh/` directory)
20: - [x] Implement installation to `~/.oh-my-zsh/custom/completions/_openspec` for Oh My Zsh
21: - [x] Implement fallback installation to `~/.zsh/completions/_openspec` with `fpath` updates
22: - [x] Test Zsh installer logic with mocked file system (`test/core/completions/installers/zsh-installer.test.ts`)
23: 
24: ## Phase 3: CLI Command Implementation
25: 
26: - [x] Create `src/commands/completion.ts` with `CompletionCommand` class
27: - [x] Register `completion` command in `src/cli/index.ts` with subcommands: generate, install, uninstall
28: - [x] Implement `generateSubcommand()` that outputs Zsh script to stdout
29: - [x] Implement `installSubcommand(shell?: 'zsh')` with auto-detection for Zsh-only
30: - [x] Implement `uninstallSubcommand(shell?: 'zsh')` for removing Zsh completions
31: - [x] Add `--verbose` flag support for detailed installation output
32: - [x] Add error handling with clear messages: "Shell '<name>' is not supported yet. Currently supported: zsh"
33: - [x] Test completion command integration (`test/commands/completion.test.ts`)
34: 
35: ## Phase 4: Integration & Polish
36: 
37: - [x] Create factory pattern in `src/core/completions/factory.ts` to instantiate Zsh generator/installer (extensible for future shells)
38: - [x] Add `completion` command to command registry for self-referential completion
39: - [x] Implement dynamic completion helper functions in Zsh generator (`_openspec_complete_changes`, `_openspec_complete_specs`, `_openspec_complete_items`)
40: - [x] Add 'shell' positional type for completion command arguments
41: - [x] Test completion generation with dynamic helpers
42: - [x] Test completion install/uninstall flow
43: - [x] Verify all tests pass (97 completion tests, 340 total tests)
44: - [x] Implement auto-install via npm postinstall script
45: - [x] Add safety checks (CI detection, opt-out flag)
46: - [x] Handle Oh My Zsh vs standard Zsh installation paths
47: - [x] Add test script for postinstall validation
48: - [x] Document auto-install behavior and opt-out in README
49: - [ ] Manually test Zsh completion in Oh My Zsh environment (install, test tab completion, uninstall)
50: - [ ] Manually test Zsh completion in standard Zsh environment
51: - [ ] Test dynamic change/spec ID completion in real OpenSpec projects
52: - [ ] Verify completion cache behavior (2-second TTL)
53: - [ ] Test behavior outside OpenSpec projects (should skip dynamic completions)
54: - [x] Update `openspec --help` output to include completion command (automatically done via Commander)
55: 
56: ## Phase 5: Edge Cases & Error Handling
57: 
58: - [ ] Test and handle permission errors during installation
59: - [ ] Test and handle missing shell configuration directories (auto-create with notification)
60: - [ ] Test "already installed" detection and reinstall flow
61: - [ ] Test "not installed" detection during uninstall
62: - [ ] Verify `--no-color` flag is respected in completion command output
63: - [ ] Test shell detection failure scenarios with helpful error messages
64: - [ ] Ensure graceful handling when `$SHELL` is unset or invalid
65: - [ ] Test non-Zsh shells get clear "not supported yet" error messages
66: - [ ] Test generator output can be redirected to files without corruption
67: 
68: ## Dependencies
69: 
70: - Phase 2 depends on Phase 1 (foundation must exist first)
71: - Phase 3 depends on Phase 2 (CLI needs Zsh generator working)
72: - Phase 4 depends on Phase 3 (integration requires CLI + Zsh implementation)
73: - Phase 5 depends on Phase 4 (edge case testing after core functionality works)
74: 
75: ## Future Work (Not in This Proposal)
76: 
77: - **Bash completions** - Create bash-generator.ts and bash-installer.ts in follow-up proposal
78: - **Fish completions** - Create fish-generator.ts and fish-installer.ts in follow-up proposal
79: - **PowerShell completions** - Create powershell-generator.ts and powershell-installer.ts in follow-up proposal
80: 
81: The architecture is designed to make adding these shells straightforward by implementing the `CompletionGenerator` interface.
